title: sonic-playground concept (data/concepts/<slug>.toml)
description: One concept the reviews teach: a musical, technical or cultural idea. The file name is the slug of the term; every locale of data/i18n/ has a definition (scripts/catalog.py checks both). A review names it in taxonomies.concept and links it in prose with {{ <concept_link name="..." /> }}; its page (/concept/<slug>/) explains it and lists every track that demonstrates it.

term.description: Lowercase, as reviews write it in taxonomies.concept.

definition.description: Two or three sentences a curious listener understands without a dictionary.
